mainEntity.name: What factors have the biggest impact on the cost of a kitchen extension?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall budget depends on several variables, including the square footage of the addition, site grading, foundation requirements, and whether exterior materials like stucco need matching. Other major factors include the relocation of existing plumbing and gas lines, electrical panel capacity, and your selection of finishes such as custom cabinetry and stone countertops. A practical preparation step is to decide whether your current appliances and mechanical systems can support the expanded footprint or if upgrading your utility infrastructure will be necessary during the build.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key cost drivers include the extension's square footage, foundation needs, exterior wall tie-ins, utility relocations, and finish choices like cabinetry and countertops.
